dass21.label: DASS-21 (Depression, Anxiety, Stress Scales)
dass21.instructions:
Please read each statement and select a number 0, 1, 2 or 3 which indicates how much the statement applied to you over the past week. There are no right or wrong answers. Do not spend too much time on any statement.
0 = Did not apply to me at all
1 = Applied to me to some degree, or some of the time
2 = Applied to me to a considerable degree or a good part of time
3 = Applied to me very much or most of the time

When I read, I often find that I:

(A) Read out loud or hear the words inside my head.
(K) Fidget and try to “feel” the content.

items.prompt: When asked to give directions, I:
options: (V) See the actual places in my mind as I say them or prefer to draw them.
(A) Having no difficulty in giving them verbally.
(K) Have to point or move my body as I give them.

items.prompt: If I am unsure how to
options: (V) Write it in order to determine if it looks right.
(A) Spell it out loud inorder to determine if it sounds right
(K) Write it in order to determine if it looks right.

items.prompt: When I write I:
options: (A) Said them over and over to myself.
(K) Push hard on my part or pencil and can feel the flow of the words.

items.prompt: If I had to remember a list of items, I would remember best if:
options: (A) Said them over and over to myself.
(K) Move around and used my fingers to name each item.

items.prompt: I prefer teachers who:
options: (V) Use a board or overhead projector while they lecture

items.prompt: When trying to concentrate, I have a difficult time when:
options: (V) There is a lot of clutter or movement in the room
(A) There is a lot of noise in the room.
(K) I have to sit still for any length.

items.prompt: When solving a problem I:
options: (V) Write or draw diagrams to see it.
(K) Use my entire body or move objects to help me think.

items.prompt: When given written instructions on how to build something, I:
options: (V) Read them silently and try to visualize how the parts will fit together.
(A) Read them out loud and talk to myself as I put the part together.
(K) Try to put the parts together first and read later.

items.prompt: To keep occupied while waiting, I:
options: (K) Walk around, manipulate things with my hands, or move/shake my feet as I sit.

items.prompt: If I had to verbally describe something to another person, I would:
options: (V) Be brief because I do not like to talk at length.
(A) Go into great detail because I like to talk.
(K) Gesture and move around while talking.

items.prompt: If someone were verbally describing something to another person, I would:
options: (V) Try to visualize what he/she was saying.
(A) Enjoy listening but want to interrupt and talk myself.

items.prompt: When trying to recall names, I remember:
